summary: Implementation plan for Uni Connect: Full-featured Smart Campus OS & Security Sentinel Hub. Encompasses the complete student experience (Digital Keycard with Proximity Radar & interactive beacon simulator, Automated Attendance with live session metrics, Emergency SOS tactile station, Events & Campus Pulse, Facility Study Spaces crowd rhythm predictor, and multilingual Settings) and the authoritative Campus Operations & Security Hub (Live CCTV & Thermal AI feeds, Headcount & granular zone analytics, Access Controls with 3s master lockdown override, and Tier 3+ Biometric Enclave auth) with a seamless dual-mode role switcher.
